items.html: Then that illumination is drawn downward to the forehead of Aba veIma, from outside, and shines in their Mochin; and from there it is drawn to the forehead of Zeir Anpin, and the judgments and Gevurot are subdued from there by the force of the crown (Atara) of Gevura, which is there in the Da'at, within the forehead of Zeir Anpin, and they are sweetened. And from there that illumination is further drawn to the eyes of Zeir Anpin, and then he is able to raise his eyes and gaze upon the forehead of Arich Anpin, and a great light descends to him from there afterwards. Now, when all these lights descend from the Bina of Atik as above, of necessity the light of the Hochma of Atik descends concealed within the illumination of the Bina, and it too shines below in the forehead in the aforementioned manner, for there is the Hochma of Zeir Anpin, and it receives illumination, as above.
